page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, and is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the instance delivers average multi-core processing capabilities, as evidenced by its middle-tier performance in multi-threaded stress-ng and Geekbench tests. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng single-core and the bottom 10% for Geekbench single-core and single-threaded gzip compression. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds for large blocks, though the overall Passmark memory score falls into the bottom 25%.

Given its high memory density relative to compute resources, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-threaded CPU performance. The lack of local storage means storage performance depends entirely on network-attached volumes. It is suitable for workloads such as caching layers, Redis databases, multi-threaded data processing, and moderate web serving operations.
